The initial checkpoint failed with:

```text
error: trigger must be a function call, a field access, or arithmetic operator
  --> candidate.rs:12:46
```

That was caused by `#[trigger]` annotations attached to whole existential conjunctions in the `choose` expressions. I removed those annotations.

I then restructured the proof so each direction of the set equality is handled by an explicit `if` on the relevant membership hypothesis before selecting a witness. For the forward direction, this makes the existential witness for `(s1 + s2).map(f)` available, splits on whether the preimage is in `s1` or `s2`, and rebuilds membership in `s1.map(f) + s2.map(f)`. For the reverse direction, it splits on which image contains `x` and rebuilds membership in `(s1 + s2).map(f)`. I added explicit `vstd::set::axiom_set_union` calls to justify the union membership steps, and used the fully qualified `vstd::set_lib::assert_sets_equal!` macro rather than a top-level macro import.
